title: An Inspiring Individual
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this person is
How you know or learned about them
What qualities or achievements you admire in them
prompt: Describe a person who has inspired you.
finalPoint: Explain why this person serves as an inspiration in your life.

title: An Engaging Senior Citizen
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this individual is and your relationship to them
How often and where you converse with them
What subjects or stories you typically discuss
prompt: Describe an elderly person you enjoy talking to.
finalPoint: Explain why you find communicating with this person rewarding and interesting.

title: A Peer with Leadership Capabilities
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this person is and how you know them
What leadership roles or responsibilities they have undertaken
How they behave when managing or collaborating with others
prompt: Describe a friend or colleague who is an effective leader.
finalPoint: Explain why you consider this person to be a good leader.

title: A Public Figure in Contemporary Media
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this public figure is
Why they frequently appear in the media
What sort of life or background they had before achieving prominence
prompt: Describe a person who is often in the news whom you would like to meet.
finalPoint: And explain what you would discuss with this person if you met them.

title: An Influential Educator
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this teacher was and the academic subject they taught
When and where you were taught by them
What pedagogical methods or personal approaches they utilized
prompt: Describe a teacher who significantly influenced your educational development.
finalPoint: Explain how this teacher shaped your attitude toward learning.

title: An Altruistic Individual
domain: Interpersonal Profiles and Personalities
bullets: Who this individual is and how you became acquainted with them
What kinds of assistance or support they provide
How often and under what circumstances they offer this help
prompt: Describe a person you know who frequently helps others.
finalPoint: And explain how you feel about their contributions and character.

title: A Desired Living Space
domain: Architectural Spaces, Geography, and Physical Environments
bullets: Where this residence would be located
What architectural style and interior design it would feature
Who you would live with in this home
prompt: Describe a house or apartment you would like to live in.
finalPoint: And explain why you would choose to live in this specific place.

title: A Significant Historical Site
domain: Architectural Spaces, Geography, and Physical Environments
bullets: What the historical place is and where it is situated
When and with whom you visited the location
What historical significance or architectural features it possesses
prompt: Describe a historical place you have visited.
finalPoint: Explain why this historical visit left a strong impression on you.

title: A Tranquil Environment
domain: Architectural Spaces, Geography, and Physical Environments
bullets: Where this place is located
When and how frequently you visit it
What activities you engage in while there
prompt: Describe a place that you find exceptionally peaceful.
finalPoint: And explain why this environment induces a sense of calm and peace.

title: A Densely Populated Public Space
domain: Architectural Spaces, Geography, and Physical Environments
bullets: Where this place is and when you went there
Why this location was populated with so many people
What you did while navigating the environment
prompt: Describe a crowded place you have visited.
finalPoint: Explain how you felt about being in such a crowded setting.

title: An Aesthetically Distinct Urban Setting
domain: Architectural Spaces, Geography, and Physical Environments
bullets: What city it is and when you traveled there
How you traveled and who accompanied you
What prominent landmarks or landscape features characterized the city
prompt: Describe a city you visited that you consider exceptionally beautiful.
finalPoint: And explain why you found the urban aesthetic so memorable.

title: A Meaningful Presentation Gift
domain: Material Objects, Technological Artifacts, and Possessions
bullets: What the gift was and who presented it to you
On what specific milestone or occasion you received it
What the physical appearance or utility of the object was
prompt: Describe a special gift you received on an important occasion.
finalPoint: And explain why this gift held exceptional personal significance.

title: A High-Utility Digital Application or Website
domain: Material Objects, Technological Artifacts, and Possessions
bullets: What the platform is and how you initially discovered it
How frequently you access it and for what operational purposes
What distinct features or content it offers
prompt: Describe a useful website or digital platform you regularly use.
finalPoint: Explain why this digital tool is indispensable to your daily routine.

title: A Notable Work of Visual Art
domain: Material Objects, Technological Artifacts, and Possessions
bullets: What the artwork is and who created it
Where and when you first viewed it
What subject matter, medium, or style it represents
prompt: Describe a piece of art (such as a painting or sculpture) that you like.
finalPoint: Explain why this piece of art resonates with you aesthetically.

title: Specialized Institutional Attire
domain: Material Objects, Technological Artifacts, and Possessions
bullets: What the uniform looked like in terms of design and material
When, where, and under what institutional rules you were required to wear it
How you acquired and maintained the uniform
prompt: Describe a uniform you have worn for school or professional employment.
finalPoint: Explain how you felt about wearing this standardized clothing.

title: An Underutilized Consumer Acquisition
domain: Material Objects, Technological Artifacts, and Possessions
bullets: What the product was and when you bought it
Why you decided to purchase the item initially
How often or in what manner you have actually used it
prompt: Describe an item you purchased but have not used very much.
finalPoint: And explain why you ended up using this item far less than anticipated.

title: A Logistically Disrupted Journey
domain: Episodic Events, Life Transitions, and Narrative Incidents
bullets: Where you were traveling and what mode of transport you utilized
Who accompanied you on this trip
What unforeseen complications or delays occurred
prompt: Describe a journey that did not go according to your original plans.
finalPoint: And explain how you resolved the disruption and what you would do differently in the future.

title: A Pivotal Personal Decision
domain: Episodic Events, Life Transitions, and Narrative Incidents
bullets: What the decision entailed
When and why you were required to make this choice
What alternative options or factors you had to evaluate
prompt: Describe an important decision you made that significantly affected your life.
finalPoint: And explain how this decision altered the trajectory of your life.

title: A Demanding Accomplishment
domain: Episodic Events, Life Transitions, and Narrative Incidents
bullets: What the task or project involved
When and why you undertook this difficult endeavor
What specific obstacles arose and how you addressed them
prompt: Describe a challenging task or project that you successfully completed.
finalPoint: And explain why completing this project was both challenging and gratifying.

title: An Unplanned or Memorable Celebration
domain: Episodic Events, Life Transitions, and Narrative Incidents
bullets: What the occasion was and where it was hosted
Who attended and what activities took place
What food, entertainment, or cultural rituals were included
prompt: Describe a special celebration or party you attended.
finalPoint: And explain why this celebration left a lasting impression on you.

title: Receipt of Critical Information
domain: Episodic Events, Life Transitions, and Narrative Incidents
bullets: What the news was and who communicated it to you
When and via what medium you received it
What immediate actions you took upon hearing it
prompt: Describe a time when you received important or welcome news.
finalPoint: Explain why this piece of information had such a strong impact on you.

title: A Physical Conditioning Regimen
domain: Behavioral Habits, Skills, Repertoire, and Recreation
bullets: What the activity is and how it is performed
When and where you typically participate in it
What equipment or environmental settings are required
prompt: Describe an exercise or athletic activity you do to maintain fitness.
finalPoint: Explain why you consider this activity effective for your physical well-being.

title: An Acquired Skill or Competency
domain: Behavioral Habits, Skills, Repertoire, and Recreation
bullets: What the skill is and who taught it to you
How long it took to acquire competence
What training methods, tools, or practice routines you utilized
prompt: Describe a practical skill you learned over a period of time.
finalPoint: Explain how this skill has proven useful in your personal or professional life.

title: A Post-Obligation Decompression Routine
domain: Behavioral Habits, Skills, Repertoire, and Recreation
bullets: What the activity involves
Where and with whom you engage in it
How frequently you dedicate time to this routine
prompt: Describe an activity you do after work or study to relax.
finalPoint: And explain why this particular activity alleviates stress and restores mental energy.

title: A Structured Childhood Game
domain: Behavioral Habits, Skills, Repertoire, and Recreation
bullets: What the game was and what basic rules governed it
Where you typically played it and with whom
What equipment or physical spaces were required
prompt: Describe a traditional or recreational game you played in your childhood.
finalPoint: And explain what made this game particularly engaging to you as a child.

title: A Memorable Interpersonal Dialogue
domain: Behavioral Habits, Skills, Repertoire, and Recreation
bullets: Whom you spoke with and where the interaction occurred
What core subject matter or points were explored
How the other participant contributed to the exchange
prompt: Describe an engaging conversation you had with another individual.
finalPoint: And explain why this dialogue stimulated your interest or altered your perspective.

title: Informative Health Communication
domain: Systems, Media, Abstract Phenomena, and Societal Issues
bullets: What the article discussed and where you accessed it
When you read this material
What specific scientific evidence or lifestyle advice the author presented
prompt: Describe an article or publication on health that you found informative.
finalPoint: Explain how the insights from this publication could improve public or individual health.

title: A Compelling Literary Work
domain: Systems, Media, Abstract Phenomena, and Societal Issues
bullets: What the book is and who authored it
What genre it belongs to and what core narrative or theme it develops
When and over what duration you read it
prompt: Describe an engaging book you recently finished reading.
finalPoint: And explain why you found this literary work captivating.

title: Institutional Environmental Legislation
domain: Systems, Media, Abstract Phenomena, and Societal Issues
bullets: What the law regulates and how you learned about it
Which segments of society or industries are affected by it
How compliance with this policy is enforced
prompt: Describe a law or public policy concerning environmental protection in your country.
finalPoint: And explain whether you believe this legal framework is effective in preserving ecological balance.

title: A Targeted Community Modification
domain: Systems, Media, Abstract Phenomena, and Societal Issues
bullets: What specific infrastructural or social intervention is needed
What local problems or systemic inefficiencies necessitate this change
How local authorities or civic groups could execute this improvement
prompt: Describe a positive change you would like to see implemented in your local community.
finalPoint: Explain how this development would elevate the overall quality of life in the area.
